# E20. Physics analysis v1 and v2

The fixed comparison has four groups of three full particle-off suites, plus the original combined run kept separately. No run was added or replaced after seeing its ratio. The 0.95 line is unchanged.

V1 is unchanged. V2 keeps the trial window untouched and maps its physics-step offsets and observed endpoint placement onto the no-wall trajectory. It divides the matched baseline displacement by its own elapsed timestamps, never by a forced second or nominal tick rate. Missing corresponding observations remain unresolved.

Full precision arrays and per-run counts are in `data/E20/analysis-v2/physics-side-by-side-1/ratios-and-counts.json`. Each list is in round/trial order; no resolved ratio is trimmed.
